items.text: The goal is the decisions that unlock high income opportunities through a high-value skill portfolio and a clearer route toward earlier financial freedom, not just the safest-sounding option in the placement group.
Guidance is delivered fully online across India, so you can start from your hostel, home, or college without waiting for a campus counsellor or a local office.
